title: The rail maps' headers: res/field/rails/headers.json
description: The files of ARCID_RAIL_DATA (a/1/1/0), in order: the header that FieldNoGridMapper_LoadByHeader reads for a rail ID, which GetRailIDForZone gives a zone (ZONE_RAIL_ASSIGNMENTS in src/system/zonedata.c). tools/data/rail_data.py packs them.

rail.description: The rail file, res/field/rails/<n>.json, or null for none (NOGRID_RAIL_NONE)

camera_areas.description: The camera areas, res/field/cameras/rail_areas/<n>.json, a file of ARCID_FIELD_SCENE_AREA (LoadCameraDataToSceneAreaLoader), or null for none (NOGRID_CAMERA_NONE)
